description.echo: Try a simple two-step pipeline that just echoes your input back. Great for learning how runs work.
description.failure: Run a workflow that fails on purpose so you can see how errors look and get reported.
description.repurpose: Take a long video and turn it into a short clip sized for social feeds.
description.productVideo: Generate a product video end-to-end: script, voice, and final render.
description.probe: Upload a media file and get a quick technical report (length, size, codecs).
description.extractAudio: Pull the audio track out of a video and save it as a separate file.
description.default: Run this pipeline with your own input and download the result when it finishes.
